title: Fire & Blood: 300 Years Before A Game of Thrones
description: The thrilling history of the Targaryens in Westeros, chronicling the rise of the dragonlords and the brutal civil war known as the Dance of the Dragons that nearly tore the realm apart.

title: A Game of Thrones
series: A Song of Ice and Fire
description: Winter is coming. In a realm where summers span decades and winters can last a lifetime, noble families wage ruthless political warfare for the Iron Throne of Westeros while an ancient terror awakens beyond the Wall.

title: A Clash of Kings
series: A Song of Ice and Fire
description: A comet the color of blood and flame cuts across the sky as five rival contenders vie for the Iron Throne. From King's Landing to the frozen lands beyond the Wall, civil war consumes the Seven Kingdoms.

title: A Storm of Swords
series: A Song of Ice and Fire
description: The War of the Five Kings reaches its devastating crescendo. As bitter betrayals and the notorious Red Wedding shatter alliances, Daenerys Targaryen amasses an army of Unsullied and frees the slaves of Slaver's Bay.

title: A Knight of the Seven Kingdoms
description: Centuries before the events of A Game of Thrones, the hedge knight Ser Duncan the Tall and his diminutive squire Egg—destined to become King Aegon V Targaryen—wander the Seven Kingdoms during the golden age of chivalry.

title: Harry Potter and the Sorcerer's Stone
description: Harry Potter has never even heard of Hogwarts when the letters start dropping on the doormat. On his eleventh birthday, a great beetle-eyed giant of a man called Rubeus Hagrid bursts in with astonishing news: Harry Potter is a wizard.

title: Harry Potter and the Chamber of Secrets
description: Harry Potter's summer includes a visit from a house-elf warning of great danger at Hogwarts. Strange whispers in the walls, petrified students, and the legend of the hidden Chamber of Secrets unleash dark secrets from the school's past.

title: Harry Potter and the Prisoner of Azkaban
description: For twelve long years, the dread fortress of Azkaban held the notorious mass murderer Sirius Black. Now he has escaped, soul-sucking Dementors patrol the school gates, and Harry must confront the haunting truth about his parents' death.

title: Harry Potter and the Goblet of Fire
description: Hogwarts hosts the prestigious Triwizard Tournament between European wizarding academies. When the magical Goblet of Fire mysteriously selects underage Harry as a fourth champion, he must survive mortal trials and the return of Lord Voldemort.

title: Harry Potter and the Order of the Phoenix
description: The Ministry of Magic denies Voldemort's return and sends the tyrannical Dolores Umbridge to inspect Hogwarts. In response, Harry covertly trains Dumbledore's Army to prepare his fellow students for the impending war.

title: Harry Potter and the Deathly Hallows
description: The final battle begins. Harry, Ron, and Hermione abandon Hogwarts to hunt down and destroy the remaining Horcruxes. In the climactic Battle of Hogwarts, Harry faces Voldemort in a duel that decides the fate of the wizarding world.

title: The Hobbit
description: Bilbo Baggins is a hobbit who enjoys a comfortable, unambitious life. But his contentment is interrupted when the wizard Gandalf and a company of thirteen dwarves arrive on his doorstep to enlist him in a quest to raid the treasure hoard of Smaug the Dragon.

title: The Fellowship of the Ring
description: The dark power of Sauron grows across Mordor. Frodo Baggins inherits the One Ring of Power and embarks on a treacherous pilgrimage to Mount Doom with a fellowship of men, elves, dwarves, and hobbits to destroy it forever.

title: The Two Towers
description: The Fellowship has broken. Aragorn, Legolas, and Gimli rally the defenders of Rohan at Helm's Deep, while Frodo and Samwise journey deeper into shadow guided by the wretched creature Gollum.

title: The Last Wish: Introducing the Witcher
description: Geralt of Rivia is a Witcher, a mutated monster hunter who stalks supernatural threats for coin. This foundational collection introduces Geralt, his tempestuous romance with the sorceress Yennefer, and his fateful run-ins with a capricious djinn.

title: Sword of Destiny
description: Geralt encounters golden dragons, sirens, and dryads while wrestling with the inexorable pull of destiny that forever binds his life to Princess Ciri, the Child of Surprise whose magical lineage will reshape the Continent.

title: Fourth Wing
description: Twenty-year-old Violet Sorrengail enters the brutal Basgiath War College where candidates must bond with fearsome dragons or perish. With dragons that incinerate the weak and cutthroat rivals at every turn, survival is the only test that matters.

title: Iron Flame
description: Everyone expected Violet Sorrengail to die during her first year at Basgiath War College. But now the real training begins, the leadership is desperate to break her, and Navarre's deadly secrets threaten to destroy everything.

title: Mistborn: The Final Empire
description: For a thousand years the ash fell and no flowers bloomed under the reign of the immortal Lord Ruler. Kelsier, a brilliant thief who survived the Pits of Hathsin, recruits street urchin Vin into an audacious plan to topple God himself using the power of Allomancy.

title: The Way of Kings
description: Roshar is a world of stone and tempestuous Highstorms. On the shattered plains, Kaladin—a former surgeon forced into slavery as a bridge runner—must discover the ancient powers of the Knights Radiant to protect those who cannot protect themselves.

title: The Name of the Wind
description: The intimate confession of Kvothe—a magically gifted musician, scholar, and legendary adventurer who grew up in a troupe of traveling performers before entering the prestigious University to study sympathy and search for the mythical Chandrian.

title: The Lightning Thief
description: Twelve-year-old Percy Jackson discovers he is a demigod, son of Poseidon. When Zeus's master lightning bolt is stolen, Percy is accused of the crime and must journey across America to the underworld to recover it and avert a war of the gods.

title: The Sea of Monsters
description: Camp Half-Blood's magical borders are failing after Thalia's tree is poisoned. Percy Jackson and his friends must sail into the perilous Sea of Monsters (the Bermuda Triangle) to retrieve the mythical Golden Fleece and rescue Grover.

title: Dune
description: Set on the desert planet Arrakis, Dune tells the story of Paul Atreides, heir to a noble family entrusted with ruling an inhospitable world where the only valuable commodity is the spice melange, capable of extending life and enhancing thought.

title: The Lion, the Witch and the Wardrobe
description: Four adventurous siblings step through a wardrobe door into the land of Narnia, a frozen realm trapped in perpetual winter by the White Witch, awaiting the return of the Great Lion Aslan to break the enchantment.
